engineDependencies.description: Needs the declared atmosphere wall and suit-timer consumer; gravity physics already has a registered consumer.

boardRow.name: The Mare Claim
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A high crater rim rings dome pads, regolith fields, and an eastbound mass-driver.

goals: Build among the dome cluster and crater-rim pads.
Work the six regolith harvest grounds across the mare flat.
Watch the launch pad, lava-tube mouth, and eastbound mass-driver rail.
rules: The crater rim stands at height six above the mare flat.
Seven surveyed build grounds span the rim and mare flat.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The claim is not made until four of the six regolith grounds are worked with air still in the suit.
Only one ground counts in each four-wave window, so the run is made in trips; a ground worked while her suit is empty counts for nothing.
Outside the domes there is no air. The hero lands six paces north of the dome cluster with sixty seconds in her suit, and only a breathing dome fills it.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.
briefing.geographyLine: A height-six crater rim rings a height-zero mare with dome pads, regolith fields, a lava-tube mouth, launch pad, and eastbound mass-driver rail.

contracts.name: The Far Side
contracts.description: Mare Claim terrain variant. Engine dependency: map-wide signal suppression, suit-only atmosphere, and one-time crashed-probe playback consumers are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: remove Earth, drones, and playbooks so the town's first hello becomes the reward for crossing the loneliest map in the saga.

objectiveMetadata.description: Cross the comms shadow in a suit and recover the unmarked probe that kept the town's first wrong-number hello.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Homesickness by subtraction: the missing Earth, drones, and playbooks make the recovered voice matter.

probeRecoveryZones.description: A half-buried, unmarked old-world probe waits at the far end of the crossing.

signalNullZones.description: No playbooks or drones operate anywhere in the Far Side comms shadow.

engineDependencies.description: Signal suppression, probe recovery and playback have consumers, and the headless door now composes the suit-only atmosphere wall: the suit drains outside the landing yard and the crossing counts only on air. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so a player there meets no suit timer and this dependency stays missing until it does.

signalSuppression.description: The Far Side comms shadow disables drones and playbooks for the whole run.

probePlayback.description: The recovered probe plays the valley-to-lighthouse wrong-number call once at the map's end.

boardRow.name: The Far Side
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A landing yard faces a listening-probe crater across the Far Side.

goals: Cross from the landing yard to the listening-probe crater.
Build at the two surveyed grounds on opposite ends of the Far Side.
rules: Earth is absent from the sky.
The Far Side reuses the Mare Claim rim-and-flat ground.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The crossing is not made until four separate entries into the listening-probe crater are credited with air still in the suit.
Only one crossing counts in each four-wave window, so the vacuum is crossed again and again; an entry made on an empty suit counts for nothing.
The hero makes the crossing herself. Her suit holds sixty seconds of air and only the landing yard fills it; the crater lies sixty-eight paces out.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.
briefing.geographyLine: The Mare Claim rim-and-flat terrain with a landing yard at one end and the listening-probe crater at the other.

contracts.name: Low Orbit
contracts.description: Distinct non-ground scaffold tile. Engine dependency: zero-G movement, returning orbital projectiles, debris-terrain, and handhold-route consumers are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: momentum is commitment; every push and every missed lob remains a future problem.

objectiveMetadata.description: Cross the rebuilt Claw scaffold by handholds while returning misses and drifting debris keep every commitment in play.

engineDependencies.description: Zero-gravity projectile physics, the scaffold decks, the debris bands and the handhold spine all run, and the headless door now composes the suit-only atmosphere wall: crossing every authored deck on suit air is what opens the secure. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so this dependency stays missing until it does.

zeroGravity.description: The station scaffold is in free fall; missed lobs remain in orbit and return.

boardRow.name: Low Orbit
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The Salvage King's rebuilt Claw spans three scaffold decks between two debris fields.

goals: Cross the salvaged Claw scaffold by its central spine.
Build across the carcass yard and both scaffold decks.
rules: Three surveyed decks divide the orbital yard.
Two debris fields flank the central spine.
Waves enter from the west and east.
The scaffold is not crossed until the hero has stood on both outboard decks and four separate deck entries are credited with air still in her suit.
Only one crossing counts in each four-wave window, so the spine is worked all run; an entry made on an empty suit counts for nothing.
Only the carcass yard holds air. The two scaffold decks are open frame in vacuum, and her suit holds sixty seconds.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.
briefing.geographyLine: The Salvage King's Claw rebuilt as a three-deck orbital yard, with a handhold spine between two drifting debris fields.

contracts.name: The Eclipse
contracts.description: Mare Claim terrain variant. Engine dependency: a one-shot event-driven eclipse cycle, mid-run solar shutdown, brown-out ledger, and dark-wave consumers are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: reserves are love letters to your future self.

objectiveMetadata.description: Keep the Mare Claim alive when an early lunar eclipse kills the solar economy in the middle of the run.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Reserves are love letters to your future self.

eclipseShadowZones.description: The eclipse shadow crosses the whole claim and ends solar production mid-run.

engineDependencies.description: The headless door now composes the atmosphere wall and the eclipse event: mid-run the shadow takes the solar-fed dome pads offline, leaves the pad nearest the claim as the reserve, and the secure then needs a regolith ground worked on suit air after it lands. The authored shadow-zone rectangle itself still has no consumer, and the BROWSER composes neither the atmosphere nor the eclipse, so this dependency stays missing.

eclipseEvent.description: A compressed lunar eclipse arrives mid-run, early and unannounced the first time, shutting down solar production and opening dark waves.

boardRow.name: The Eclipse
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The Mare Claim's dome pads, regolith fields, and mass-driver return beneath a dark sky.

goals: Build among the Mare Claim's dome cluster and rim pads.
Work the six regolith harvest grounds across the flat.
rules: Seven surveyed build grounds span the rim and mare flat.
The eastbound mass-driver rail crosses the southern footing.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The claim is not made until four of the six regolith grounds are worked with air still in the suit.
Only one ground counts in each four-wave window, so the run is made in trips; a ground worked while her suit is empty counts for nothing.
Outside the domes there is no air. The hero lands six paces north of the dome cluster with sixty seconds in her suit, and the shadow leaves just one dome breathing.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.
briefing.geographyLine: The Mare Claim rim, dome cluster, regolith fields, launch pad, and mass-driver rail beneath a dark sky.
